title: The Runtime's export of the native agent attempt that produced a specification review (REQ-031, CR-026): bound to the review, its attempt, the specification revision, its digest and its commit, never to a candidate. contracts/native-attempt.schema.json stays the record of candidate verifiers.

status.description: Exported only from the attempt's COMPLETED TaskResult; any other ending has no export and no report.

review_id.description: The review_id of the spec_review.opened event the attempt's task belongs to.

stdout_sha256.description: sha256 of the turn's raw stdout log, the report's raw_session.
